messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Metoprolol crosses the placenta and passes into breast milk in small amounts.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, planning a pregnancy, or breastfeeding.
Studies published to date have not shown a link between metoprolol taken in pregnancy and major birth defects or miscarriage.
Reports on growth restriction, early birth, and death around the time of birth have been inconsistent.
Those studies have limitations that make them hard to interpret.
Untreated high blood pressure and untreated heart failure in pregnancy carry their own serious risks for both mother and baby.
Babies born to mothers taking metoprolol may have low blood pressure, low blood sugar, a slow heartbeat, or slow breathing.
So, they are watched after birth.
The amount of metoprolol a breastfed baby receives is estimated at 0.05 mg to under 1 mg a day.
This amount is about 0.5% to 2% of the mother's weight-adjusted dose.
No side effects in breastfed babies have been identified.
Babies are still monitored for a slow heartbeat and for signs such as unusual sleepiness.

The relation 'has study limitation' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject study has limitations that make it difficult to interpret the results as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. B. 'may be less effective in': The subject drug may not work as well in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'does not act on': The subject drug does not exert its effects directly on the entity specified by the object entity.
